# East Coast Utility, LLC

> Horizontal directional drilling (HDD) and underground utility construction
> contractor based in Fair Haven, New Jersey. Founded 2008 by Thomas Colleran.
> Serves New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Delaware, and Maryland.

East Coast Utility installs underground utilities without open excavation, using
horizontal directional drilling. Work includes pilot hole drilling, reaming, and
pipe pullback for water, gas, sewer, electric, and telecommunications lines.

## Services

- Horizontal directional drilling (HDD) and trenchless installation
- Road, highway, and railroad utility crossings
- Water main, sewer, and service lateral installation
- Gas distribution main installation
- Fiber optic and telecommunications conduit
- Municipal traffic signal and street lighting conduit

## Service area

New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland.
Based in Fair Haven, New Jersey 07704.

## Experience

Utility and infrastructure clients include PSE&G, American Water, UGI
Corporation, New Jersey Natural Gas, and Elizabethtown Gas. Federal work
includes fiber optic installation at McGuire Air Force Base.
